about: INT-385: how one clinical quantity is written, per display locale. Both renderers are held to this one table: tests/records/test_quantity_render.py holds intake_platform.records.quantity_atom to it, and apps/mobile/src/lib/records/extraction.test.ts holds the app's formatQuantity (lib/health/format.ts) to it, so the server and the app cannot drift apart. The decimal separator is the locale's (tr: comma, en: full stop). Digits are never grouped (useGrouping:false). Number and unit are one atom, joined by U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE (CLAUDE.md invariant 22). The four magnitudes are the ones INT-385 names (12.5, 12500, 0.05, 1,5). They are arbitrary test magnitudes, not reference values, and no figure is computed over them (invariant 20). `value` is the magnitude the way JSON and Decimal carry it, with a full stop. It is data, not a rendering.
